description: Dated prices for one product: today's verified price for this exact model (price_verified; when it is not verified the price is null and price_unverified_reason says Price not confirmed and why), when iDevice began checking it (tracking_since) and on how many days (history_days). Lows come only from verified checks of this exact model, one price a day: none under 30 days of checks; from 30 to 89 days the low (lowest_checked) with the days it covers (low_period_days, low_period), and lowest_last_30_days with the 30-day low and high; lowest_last_90_days only when 90 days are covered. Also the researched history (first and last observation, range, the points themselves, with bundles and refurbs marked and left out of the range).
name: get_price_history
title: Price history
